gates.name: 1 numerical stability (all arrays finite)
gates.reason: §6b item 1: stability gate, not accuracy; no E-derived threshold

gates.name: 2 deterministic reproducibility (2 runs bitwise + equal hashes)
gates.threshold: np.array_equal on all arrays + equal output_hash + equal config_hash

gates.name: 3 successful completion (n_steps + step*dt sample grid)
gates.reason: §6b item 3: completion gate, pre-registered from config

gates.name: 4a conservation max|dE/E0|
gates.reason: §6b item 4: frozen stability bound (Phase-3 basis, NOT derived from E)

gates.name: 4b conservation max|P_rel|
gates.reason: §6b item 4: frozen stability bound; P_rel = |P(t) - P(0)| / sum_i m_i |v_i(t)| (masses = GM/G)

gates.name: 4c conservation max|ΔL|/|L0|
gates.reason: §6b item 4: frozen stability bound (Phase-3 RK4 basis, NOT derived from E)

gates.name: 5 valid metadata/provenance (§6d fields + kernel hashes == manifest)
gates.threshold: all §6d fields present, kernel hashes match manifest

gates.name: 6 absence of numerical failure (evidence: gates 1 + 3)
gates.reason: §6b item 6 (points at items 1 and 3 — no separate threshold)
